turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm reviewing the architecture for the new search index. It's getting heavy on the GPU cluster.
That can definitely drive up costs. Have you considered optimizing the model size or using quantization?
I'm thinking bigger picture. For our search and personalization stack, Distilling the LLM is proposed as an alternative to serving it.
Understood. So you prefer distillation over standard serving for those specific tasks to reduce latency and cost.
Exactly. By the way, did you see the rain forecast for Tuesday? I need to bring an umbrella.
Yes, heavy showers expected around 3 PM. You might want to schedule your commute earlier if possible.
Good point. I'll adjust my calendar. Also, the coffee machine in the breakroom is leaking again.
I've flagged that for facilities. They usually take a day to fix non-critical plumbing issues.
